content_zh:
这老夫人自然不是白家老夫人，而是于蓉的亲生母亲，也便是白振祥的姨母于老夫人。
十几年前，于老夫人有意让自己的外甥迎娶于蓉，可白振祥嫌弃于家无法给自己带来帮助，所以只是让于蓉为妾，娶的则是蓝家之女蓝月。
等蓝月死后，他就将于蓉抬为了正室夫人，并且经不住于蓉的哭诉，把于老夫人接来了白家居住，更是孝敬如亲母。
有一个于蓉这样的女儿，于老夫人也不是节约的人，因此多年下来，蓝月带来的嫁妆已经被这群人花的所剩无几。
“白颜，你老实交代，你的奸—夫是谁！”于老夫人高傲的仰着脑袋，如同审犯人似的厉声问道。
“与你何干？”白颜唇角浅扬，冷眸俯视着坐在面前的于老夫人，淡淡的说道。
“放肆！”于老夫人愤怒的拍向桌面，“我是你外祖母！理所应当知道你的奸-夫是谁？”
“外祖母？我的外祖母在蓝家，你只是白若姐妹的外祖母而已，少往自己脸上贴金。”
“你……”于老夫人气的老脸都变了，一个没娘的野孩子，有什么资格在她面前狂傲？
“娘，你消消气，”于蓉急忙轻抚着于老夫人的胸膛，转眸看向白颜，“白颜，其实我今天找你来，是想要告诉你一个好消息，有人不嫌弃你失贞，若你愿意打了孩子，他就纳你为妾。”
“在你看来，白家的女儿，只配为妾不成？”白颜向着两人逼近，语气中透着森寒的气息。
于老夫人冷哼一声：“你一个失贞的小贱蹄子，竟然还敢挑三拣四？我告诉你，钱家老爷子出了一枚三品的真灵丹作为聘礼，要纳你为妾！现在有男人愿意要你，你就应该感激涕零，又有什么资格挑？”
白颜眼眸微眯，眼底寒芒乍现。
“我听说钱家的家主年过半百，性情残暴，他府内的小妾经常死的不明不白！你这是打算让我去送死？”
钱家，同为四大世家之一，却以残暴闻名。
据说进入钱家的女人，都会被横着抬出来。
“臭丫头，我们白家白养了你这么多年，你难道不应该回报一下？实话告诉你吧，我儿子已经到了地阶低级，需要一枚三品的真灵丹用来突破！所以，这一次，你必须去给钱家家主为妾！”
白颜早知道这些人无耻，却没有想到，无耻到了这种境界。
她冷笑了一声：“第一，你姓于，不是白家的人！若是让不知道的人听到了，还会认为你是白家老夫人。”
“第二，你儿子需要真灵丹，与我何干？我凭什么要为了你们于家牺牲？”

“第三，你说白家养了我这么多年，可这白家是因为我娘，才能成为一流世家，就连你们身上穿的带的，哪一件不是我母亲的嫁妆？”
于老夫人气的浑身颤抖，老脸一片铁青。

content_en:
This old lady is naturally not the old lady of the Bai family, but Yu Rong's biological mother, Bai Zhenxiang's aunt, Mrs. Yu.
More than ten years ago, Mrs. Yu intended to let her nephew marry Yu Rong, but Bai Zhenxiang disliked that the Yu family could not help him, so he just made Yu Rong his concubine and married Lan Yue, the daughter of the Lan family.
After Lan Yue died, he raised Yu Rong as his wife. Unable to withstand Yu Rong's cries, he took Mrs. Yu to live in the Bai family, and she was even more filial to her like his own mother.
With a daughter like Yu Rong, Mrs. Yu is not a frugal person, so over the years, the dowry brought by Lan Yue has been spent by this group of people.
"Bai Yan, please tell me honestly, who is your adulterer!" Mrs. Yu raised her head proudly and asked sternly like she was interrogating a prisoner.
"What does it have to do with you?" Bai Yan raised her lips slightly, looked down at Mrs. Yu who was sitting in front of her with cold eyes, and said lightly.
"How presumptuous!" Mrs. Yu slapped the table angrily, "I am your grandmother! I should know who your adulterer is?"
"Grandma? My grandmother is in the Lan family. You are just sister Bai Ruo's grandmother. Don't put too much gold on yourself."
"You..." Mrs. Yu's angry face changed. What qualifications does a motherless wild child have to be arrogant in front of her?
"Mom, calm down," Yu Rong hurriedly caressed Mrs. Yu's chest and turned to look at Bai Yan, "Bai Yan, actually I came to you today to tell you good news. There is someone who doesn't dislike you for losing your virginity. If you are willing to beat the child, he will accept you as his concubine."
"In your opinion, is the daughter of the Bai family worthy only of being a concubine?" Bai Yan approached the two of them, with a cold breath in her tone.
Mrs. Yu snorted coldly: "How dare you, a little bitch who has lost her virginity, dare to be picky? Let me tell you, the old man of the Qian family gave you a third-grade true elixir as a betrothal gift, and wants to take you as his concubine! Now that a man is willing to have you, you should be grateful, so what qualifications do you have to choose?"
Bai Yan's eyes narrowed slightly, and a cold light suddenly appeared in them.
"I heard that the head of the Qian family is over fifty years old and has a cruel temper. His concubines often die in mysterious circumstances! Are you planning on letting me die?"
The Qian family is one of the four great families, but is famous for its cruelty.
It is said that women who enter Qian's house will be carried out sideways.
"Stinky girl, our Bai family has raised you for so many years, shouldn't you repay me? To tell you the truth, my son has reached the lower level of the earth level and needs a third-grade true spirit pill to break through! So, this time, you must give it to the head of the Qian family as a concubine!"
Bai Yan already knew that these people were shameless, but she didn't expect that their shamelessness would reach this level.
She sneered: "First of all, your surname is Yu, you are not from the Bai family! If someone who doesn't know hears it, they will think you are the old lady of the Bai family."
"Secondly, your son needs the true elixir, what does it have to do with me? Why should I sacrifice for your Yu family?"
"Third, you said that the Bai family has raised me for so many years, but it is because of my mother that the Bai family has become a first-class family. Even what you are wearing, which one is not my mother's dowry?"
Mrs. Yu was shaking with anger, her face was livid.
